en: The image shows a vintage black-and-white photograph, likely from the early 20th century, depicting a steam-powered boat docked by a waterfront. In the background, there is a large, ornate building with onion domes and a cross on top, which visually resembles Orthodox Christian church architecture. There are also other historic buildings and a figure walking along the shore. The boat bears the visible name 'S/S ARANDA YHTEYSALUS'.
